text: Maaku an Nulaaɗo: ko onon yimɓe, si on wonii e sikkitaare e diina am kan ka mi noddata on e muuɗum; woni diina tawhiidi, min on kan ko mi fellituɗo bonugol diina mon, mi jokkataa kan. Mi rewataa ɗin ɗin rewoton gaanin Alla. Ko mi rewata ko Alla On waroowo on, O yamirii lam nde mi laatotoo e laɓɓinamɓe Alla diina ɓen.
